weight2_route_support.divisors: {infinity}-{a/31}, 1<=a<=30, and {infinity}-{a/961}, 31 not dividing a (and their negatives)
weight2_route_support.what_is_missing: the values of the seed's primitive plus eigen-functional on these Manin symbols

FIRST_FAILURE.gate: W2-ORACLE: seed primitive plus modular symbol on the support above
FIRST_FAILURE.exact_reason: no seed eigen-symbol oracle exists in the supplied material, and neither standard construction can be executed here: (a) Hecke/Manin linear algebra over 13017263840621568 level-N Manin symbols; (b) period integrals of f along paths to a/961.
FIRST_FAILURE.ESTIMATE_note: requires a_n for n up to ~1e11 and a p-adic/archimedean comparison to the primitive integral normalisation; this is a resource statement, not a theorem that no cheaper method exists.
